stack.architecture: Strict MVC with Command Pattern & Event-Driven UI

logging.infra_usage: infra/logging.py provides infra_log(). All infra modules should use infra_log for actions, warnings, and errors.
env_vars: TALUSTRACE_LOG_FILE (write logs to file instead of console)
logging.test_pattern: See tests/infra/test_logging.py for how to capture and assert logs.

documentation_map.__instruction__: Consult these specific specs before generating code for their respective domains.

global_constraints: CRITICAL: NO circular imports. Use 'typing.TYPE_CHECKING' for type hints or lazy imports inside methods only when absolutely necessary.
The 'View' (UI) must NEVER modify the 'Model' (Core) directly. It must dispatch Actions/Commands via the API.
The 'Model' (Core) must NEVER import 'PySide6', 'ui', or depend on the event loop.

core.description: Pure logical representation (Data Models, Geometry, Electrical Rules).
core.mandate: Must remain 100% headless. Logic must be verifiably correct via unit tests without a QApplication instance.

api.description: The Controller layer. Orchestrates Commands, manages State, and handles Undo/Redo.
api.role: Single Source of Truth. The UI queries the API for state; the API does not push data to UI widgets directly (use Observer pattern).

ui.description: The View layer. Dumb rendering and event capture only.
forbidden_patterns: Business logic in widget slots (e.g., calculating wire geometry in a mouse event).
Direct modification of device attributes (e.g., 'device.x = 10'). Must use 'api.commands.run(...)'.
ui.mandate: UI components are disposable views of the underlying data.

documentation_automation.intent: The User Manual is not written manually; it is generated from metadata embedded in the Codebase. The Code is the Source of Truth.

implementation_plan.registry_source: The 'api/actions.yaml' and 'api/commands/*.py' definitions define the manual structure.
required_metadata: display_name: Human-readable title for the feature.
description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the feature does.
category: The section of the manual where this feature belongs.
implementation_plan.generator_hook: A CI/CD script will scan the Action Registry and Tool Manager to compile 'docs/generated_user_manual.md' automatically.

process: 1. WRITE TEST: Create a failing test case in 'tests/' using Pytest.
2. DEFINE INTERFACE: Stub the method or class in 'core/' or 'api/'.
3. IMPLEMENT LOGIC: Write the minimum code to pass the test.
4. LINT: Run 'flake8' on the new file. Fix all E/F/W errors immediately.
5. WIRE UI: Only after logic passes headless tests, create/update the UI widget.
test_driven_design.ui_testing_rule: Use 'pytest-qt' (qtbot) for UI tests. Mock the API backend to ensure UI tests focus only on signals/slots interaction, not business logic.

feature_definition_protocol.rule: Every new Command or Tool must include 'help_text' and 'display_name' attributes at the time of creation to support the Self-Documenting Manual.

code_quality.enforcement: Zero tolerance for linting errors in new code.
guidelines: Line length: Follow project .flake8 config (standard 88 or 120 chars).
Docstrings: Google Style required for all public methods.
Type Hinting: Mandatory for all function signatures.
